method.comparison: Use the same reset speech-activity and the same incumbent calibration tested in both window widths. A staggered or shorter finding must add a useful location on top of current evidence, with no removals.
method.rule: At least three added loud-noise useful locations across two generator families and at most one additional genuine source group, zero additional isolated backgrounds and zero new gain-only genuine flags. This panel can support a separate confirmation, since its foregrounds and backgrounds were used for earlier comparisons.
method.shorter: Use 2.5-second windows on the same 750 ms phase. Require an existing AI-leaning three-second window whose midpoint is within 750 ms of the shorter window's midpoint. Report only the overlap.
method.staggered: Add three-second windows offset by 750 ms. Require two AI-leaning three-second windows starting 1.5 s apart on either phase.
